apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.19 — The playback state machine is now defined in the player and fully implemented: lessons stop on interruption and on a media-services reset, the sound engines rebuild themselves if the system audio stack restarts, and every studio reads only its own session. Also carries the v1.5.18 session-scoping fix.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
